concerns.location: tasks.md:T003 vs spec.md:FR-001 and constitution Principle VI
concerns.text: T003 fetches only 'ACE SWICS ion composition' — FR-001 requires composition data 'from ACE/WIND archives', and Principle VI (NON-NEGOTIABLE) mandates that 'Raw ion composition measurements from the ACE SWICS instrument AND the WIND composition dataset must be stored unchanged in data/'. Dropping the WIND composition source is a silent narrowing of FR-001 and a constitution violation. Either add WIND composition ingestion to T003 or document an explicit spec amendment explaining why WIND is excluded.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Revision note & T003 vs plan.md:Summary/Scope Limitation and data-model.md:Data Flow Diagram
concerns.text: tasks.md removes the synthetic-data path, but plan.md still mandates 'exclusively uses a synthetic dataset' via generate_synthetic_data.py, and data-model.md's data flow and provenance sections still reference synthetic_config.yaml and 'the dataset is synthetic'. An implementer tracing tasks against plan/data-model gets contradictory instructions; T012's provenance block 'per the data model' would inherit synthetic provenance. Update plan.md and data-model.md to match the real-data (pyspedas/CDAWeb) approach, or note in tasks.md that plan/data-model are superseded.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Dependencies and requirement coverage table vs T010/T011
concerns.text: Coverage table cites 'pytest tests/unit/test_sensitivity.py' (FR-009) and 'tests/unit/test_significance.py' (FR-010), but no task lists these test files as deliverables — T010/T011 name only artifact files. Add the test files to T010/T011 deliverables or correct the demonstrating commands.
